title: geocontract Data Contract Catalog
description: ODCS v3.1.0 data contracts for environmental review and citizen-initiated permitting, published as a Portolan catalog. Each collection carries the contract that governs one dataset, so a consumer can read the schema, the quality rules, and the provenance before it queries any data. Federal sources are mirrored from their producing agency. Citizen proposals are originated here and published in their public projection only.
rights: The catalog metadata is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
Individual datasets inherit the license of their upstream publisher.

dataset.title: Groton Rhine St. Façade Repair — Worked Example (v2)
dataset.description: v2 canonical worked example for the citizen-permitting flow. A resident of Groton, CT (fictional) proposes repairing the masonry façade of a property at 42 Rhine Street. The action covers repointing of failed mortar joints, replacement of three cracked lintels, and reattachment of a decorative cornice. Validates against the bare ODCS v3.1.0 schema. The companion shim file (contracts/shim/groton-rhine-001.datacontract-shim.json) records the governance / quality / SLA / lineage metadata that is not represented in the ODCS body. Fictional. Illustrative only. The applicant, parcel, signature, and signatures are placeholders. The activity-code comes from the hand-curated ActivityConcept catalog v1.0 (ontology/activity-concept-catalog.v1.0.json). Anchoring is not approval; this contract's lifecycle.state is `draft` and the anchorReceipt is null.

dataset.title: NEPA Categorical Exclusions (CATEX) Catalogue
dataset.description: The federal Categorical Exclusion (CATEX) catalogue published by the Permitting Innovation Center. CATEXs are classes of actions that normally do not require further environmental review under NEPA (42 U.S.C. §§ 4321 et seq.) because they have been found not to have a significant effect on the environment, individually or cumulatively. This contract governs the 2,105 records spanning 78 federal agency units (AFRH, CPSC, DC, DHS, …). Consumers query this catalogue to determine whether a proposed action falls within an existing CATEX, the originating agency, the CFR / eCFR citation, the documented context, and any extraordinary-circumstances clause that may apply. The catalogue is published as a single 4 MB JSON file and is refreshed on an ad-hoc basis by each contributing agency. There is no per-record URL — consumers must filter client-side or via the registered mesh-gateway endpoint.

dataset.title: PIC NEPA Data Standard v1.2
dataset.description: The Permitting Innovation Center (PIC) NEPA Data & Technology Standard v1.2 — a structured schema for environmental-review data collected during reviews conducted under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), 42 U.S.C. §§ 4321 et seq. Defines 13 entity types (project, process_instance, document, comment, engagement, case_event, gis_data, gis_data_element, user_role, decision_element, process_model, process_decision_payload, legal_structure) and a uniform set of six provenance properties added in v1.2. Producers (federal / state / tribal agencies) and consumers (the public, oversight bodies, downstream applications) agree on the entity shape so that NEPA review records can be exchanged in a machine-readable, lossless form. v1.2 deliberately does not prescribe a wire format — sample payloads are published as JSON, YAML, OpenAPI, and SQL DDL. Top-level container keys use the misspelled pluralisation `processe_instances` to match the upstream source — preserved for lossless round-tripping.

dataset.title: Mirror: geocontract Federated Catalog (DCAT-US 3.0.0)
dataset.description: The geocontract federated catalog, expressed in the GSA DCAT-US 3.0.0 vocabulary. This contract governs the catalog envelope that bundles every published *.geocontract.yaml instance record — currently the NEPA Categorical Exclusions catalogue and the PIC NEPA Data Standard v1.2, with room for additional agency-published contracts to be registered over time. Consumers (mesh gateways, search indexes, dashboards, the federated harvester) resolve this catalog to discover the available datasets, their distributions (ODCS YAML + source payloads), and the data services that expose them. Each `dataset[]` entry is a DCAT-US `dcat:Dataset` whose `conformsTo` points at ODCS v3.1.0 and whose `distribution[]` enumerates the contract YAML and the source payload. DCAT-US 3.0.0 is the published federal vocabulary; the GSA repo also ships draft v3.x sub-definitions that may change. We pin the snapshot used for validation under external/dcat-us-definitions/. The catalog itself is currently an example document; production deployment will publish the catalog at https://geocontract.dev/ and the federated harvester will refresh it on a schedule.

service.title: geocontract Federated Harvester
